title: Rules learned from Stonecutter mods
text: Learn rules from Stonecutter mods: 33 open-source multi-version mods pinned in `coverage/stonecutter/mods.json`, 5,045 `//? if` switches extracted with file, method and the update their boundary falls on (`bench/stonecutter_mine.py`). Changes made the same way in two or more mods became 38 rules in `knowledge/fixes.json` (22 forward, 16 backports), each with its switches as examples and a test that self-test re-runs (`bench/stonecutter_rules.py`).
result: ZombieApocalypseAddon 1.21.1 → 26.3 stops at 50 errors instead of 69; → 1.21.6 (9) and the untouched Notes 1.21 → 1.21.6 (14) are unchanged, their errors have no repeated switch. The map shows rules learned per update.
